parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
Ensures the idempotency of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

- If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of records to return in this request.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the real-name verified registrant.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token for the next query.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The current page number. Minimum value: **1**. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of rows per page in a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The real-name verification status. Valid values:

- Approved
- Pending
- Rejected
